question: Can the product expose one evidence-bounded generic black-and-white Look Approximation while preserving both historical HP5 and Tri-X recipe identities for replay only?

product_look.selection_rule: first candidate in the frozen BW2.D0 contract; not selected from post-score performance

required_gates: catalog exposes exactly one generic B&W look and no named-stock identity
look amount zero is exact identity
look amount one is exact legacy HP5 execution parity
full and tiled execution are byte-exact
full-strength output is exactly neutral-axis RGB
invalid amounts and drifted evidence fail closed
legacy HP5 and Tri-X profile entries remain unchanged
forbidden_changes: modify the frozen safe-rich profile or its asset hashes
remove or rewrite historical HP5/Tri-X recipes
claim HP5 or Tri-X authenticity, calibration, preference, or separation
tune either legacy style on the closed BW2.D0 cohort
claim_ceiling: One deterministic generic black-and-white Look Approximation backed by BW2.D0 failure-to-separate evidence. The legacy HP5 execution is an implementation identity only, not an HP5 or Tri-X stock-response claim.
